title: Completely average, at the 50% discount price
text:
Dog seems fine with everything. None of the pieces appear to be anything special, that I couldn't buy separately, or are sourced 100% locally organic or something. At 50% off, $15, this seems about reasonable. You get several treats, of several varieties, that will last maybe a month. At full price? Seems really overpriced for what you get. Why wouldn't I go with something like rawhide chews, which are supposed to be good for dental hygiene, at 30% less in price, for a guaranteed month supply?

Overall, at this price, seems completely average. At full price, I wouldn't buy this again.
label: neutral
